name: Dot field scan (AI filtering)
summary: World overlay that visualizes filtering many options to one: dots pop onto the floor, scan rings expand from an origin and eliminate dots pass by pass, finalists get labels and glide to their marks, the winner sinks to a target with pulsing rings. Returns frame.pick (screen point) so a card can open from it.

params.area: { x0, x1, y0, y1 } spawn area in world units
params.passes: [{ at, keep }] each pass keeps N dots; the last keeps 1
params.finalists: [{ tag, home: [x, y] }] labels and marks for the dots in the second-to-last pass; the first is the winner
params.sinkTo: [x, y] where the winner glides at the final pass
params.font: canvas font for labels, e.g. '600 25px "IBM Plex Sans"'
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

changelog: v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
